# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It is the single source of agent instructions for this repo:
always link to official docs, write in your own words, respect licenses and each library's AI
policy (`ai.status` in its data file), keep each change to one entry or fix, and run
`pnpm verify` and `pnpm changes` before proposing changes. Step-by-step procedures are in
`docs/playbooks/`.
